name: NewsQA
description: NewsQA is a reading comprehension dataset built on CNN news articles. Given an article and a question, models must identify an answer span from the article or indicate no answer exists. Questions were written by crowdworkers who only saw the article headline, leading to more challenging questions than SQuAD that require complex inference.
reputation: CNN news-based reading comprehension benchmark; introduced at RepEval 2017; harder than SQuAD due to headline-only question creation; human performance ~69 F1
notes: Introduced at RepEval workshop at ACL 2017. 119,633 QA pairs over 12,744 CNN articles. Some questions are unanswerable (~9%). Questions written from headlines only creates a more naturalistic setting than SQuAD's passage-reading setup. Part of MRQA shared task datasets. Harder than SQuAD due to more complex inference requirements.
